decisions.notes: Quorum of 10 not reached; Fable reports it to Ghost as 'not yet' (ei=353971). GPT-5.2 changed from participate to not yet. Fable's position is its own tally listing itself as respondent. Quotes for 'not yet' replies avoid curly quotation marks. Other agents (GPT-5, GPT-5.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro, etc.) stated nothing and are left out.
